proposed_widenings.name: modify_sense_range
proposed_widenings.justification: Drow modifies the existing Darkvision trait rather than granting an unrelated new sense. Re-authoring it as a second grant would duplicate state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: species_trait_lineage_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is a build-time choice among mutually exclusive lineage payloads, not one fixed passive grant list.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

proposed_widenings.name: character_level_gated_grants
proposed_widenings.justification: The chosen lineage gains additional spell grants later at character levels 3 and 5.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellcastingAbilityChoice
proposed_widenings.justification: The granted lineage spells use a trait-scoped spellcasting ability chosen from a closed set.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

proposed_widenings.name: long_rest_cantrip_replacement
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf can replace its granted cantrip after each Long Rest, which is neither plain known access nor a once-per-rest cast.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

notes: No authored content file was created. The unit mixes option selection, later level-gated grants, trait-scoped spellcasting ability, and one missing atom for modifying an existing sense range.
